tagline: A fully integrated, global, commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the discovery, development, manufacturing and commercialization of gene therapies for rare genetic diseases with high unmet medical needs.
hero_kpi_rationale: VYJUVEK is the company's first commercial product and primary revenue driver, representing the majority of current financial performance. Its success determines KRYS's growth trajectory and valuation.

kpis.name: VYJUVEK Annual Revenue
kpis.explanation: Net revenues generated from the sale of VYJUVEK during fiscal year 2025, a topical gene therapy for dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa.
kpis.description: VYJUVEK is the first topical gene therapy approved in the United States, Europe, and Japan. Launched in 2023, it represents the majority of the company's revenues.
kpis.signal: First commercial product with an innovative redosable model.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: A 94% gross margin reflects the product's premium nature and potential manufacturing scale efficiencies.
kpis.signal: Very high gross margin, typical of specialized biotechs.

kpis.name: R&D Expenses
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in research and development of new gene therapies.
kpis.description: KRYS is heavily investing in R&D to advance drug candidates across multiple rare indications.
kpis.signal: Key investment to expand the gene therapy portfolio.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: Headcount supports manufacturing, clinical development, and commercial operations.
kpis.signal: Growing workforce linked to global commercial launch.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets, particularly manufacturing facilities.
kpis.description: KRYS owns two manufacturing facilities compliant with current good manufacturing practices (cGMP).
kpis.signal: Sustained Capex to maintain two commercial-scale manufacturing sites.

kpis.name: Cumulative VYJUVEK Revenue Since Launch
kpis.explanation: Total net revenues generated by VYJUVEK from its launch in August 2023 through December 31, 2025.
kpis.description: Since August 2023, KRYS has generated $730.3 million in cumulative revenue from VYJUVEK.

kpis.name: VYJUVEK Launch by Region
kpis.explanation: Geographic progression of the commercial launch of VYJUVEK across key markets.
kpis.description: The VYJUVEK launch is gradually expanding in Europe and Asia, with ongoing reimbursement discussions in Germany and France.
kpis.signal: International expansion underway with active pricing negotiations.

kpis.name: Clinical-Stage Candidates
kpis.explanation: Number and status of drug candidates in clinical development across multiple rare indications.
kpis.description: KRYS is advancing six drug candidates in areas including respiratory, ophthalmology, dermatology, oncology, and aesthetics.
kpis.signal: Diversified pipeline across multiple rare indications.

risks.title: Uncertain Pricing Negotiations in Europe
risks.score_rationale: This risk is noted as ongoing in Germany and France through 2026-2027, with strong language on reimbursement uncertainty. It directly impacts VYJUVEK's profitability, the company's main product. The Regulation category is highly weighted here.

risks.title: Dependence on a Single Commercial Product
risks.score_rationale: VYJUVEK represents all commercial revenues ($730M cumulative). The 10-K highlights future revenue volatility. Language is alarming regarding dependence. High weighting for existential risk.

risks.title: Manufacturing Complexity and cGMP Costs
risks.score_rationale: The filing mentions significant costs related to cGMP facilities, inventory adjustments, and overhead. Maintaining cGMP quality is critical. Major operational risk to margin (94%).

risks.title: Failure or Delay of Key Clinical Trials
risks.score_rationale: Several trials (IOLITE, EMERALD-1, CORAL-3) are expected to report results in 2026. The text emphasizes uncertainty in timelines and costs. Failure would mean loss of strategic pipeline. Language is highly cautious.

risks.title: Dependence on Specialized Distributors
risks.score_rationale: The distribution model relies on a limited network of specialists. The 10-K explicitly identifies this as critical for delivery. Reduced control over patient access.

risks.title: Uncertain Revenue Accounting Estimates
risks.score_rationale: The filing details uncertainty around discounts, returns, and variable revenue estimates (ASC 606). This affects financial predictability. Repeated mention in critical accounting policies.

ai_positioning.summary: KRYS does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
